svg.title: How prostt5_dataset.py turns one stored row into dataset[i]
svg.desc: ProstT5Dataset memory-maps aa.npy, threedi.npy and properties.npy of one split, trims padding to max_length 70, reads only the requested row, maps amino-acid IDs through a [256, 6] lookup and 3Di IDs to model IDs and two Foldseek coordinates, and returns x [8, 70], seed_3di [70], residue_mask [70], c [3] and dimer_index. make_dataloader stacks these rows into batches.
svg.text: mean and std per split for property_statistics()
